instanceMethods.name: ConnectNextWire
instanceMethods.signature: (saw: ShapeAnalysis_Wire, nextsewd: ShapeExtend_WireData, maxtol: number, distmin: number, revsewd: boolean, revnextsewd: boolean): { returnValue: boolean; distmin: number; revsewd: boolean; revnextsewd: boolean }
instanceMethods.returnType: { returnValue: boolean; distmin: number; revsewd: boolean; revnextsewd: boolean }
instanceMethods.comment:
Finds the best way to connect and connects <nextsewd> to already built <sewd> (in <saw>). Returns False if <nextsewd> cannot be connected, otherwise - True. <maxtol> specifies the maximum tolerance with which <nextsewd> can be added. <distmin> is used to receive the minimum distance between <nextsewd> and <sewd>. <revsewd> is True if <sewd> has been reversed before connecting. <revnextwd> is True if <nextsewd> has been reversed before connecting. Uses functionality of {@link ShapeAnalysis_Wire | `ShapeAnalysis_Wire`}.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `distmin`: updated value from the call.
- `revsewd`: updated value from the call.
- `revnextsewd`: updated value from the call.
